tagline: Fences, decks and stone work across the Okanagan — built once, built right.

testimonials.name: Priya Nair
testimonials.quote: The cedar fence has survived two winters and a windstorm without a single loose board. Neighbours keep knocking to ask who built it.

testimonials.name: Marcus Webb
testimonials.quote: They re-decked three of our rental properties in one season. On schedule every time, and the sites were cleaner than our own crews leave them.

testimonials.name: Elena Petrova
testimonials.quote: The stone retaining wall turned a slope we hated into the best part of the garden. Fair price, and they explained every cost before starting.

testimonials.name: Tom Bergeron
testimonials.quote: Our patio fence and pergola were done a week early, in the middle of patio season. Weekend lineups noticed. So did we.

testimonials.name: Aisha Khan
testimonials.quote: Good work and honest about the wait — the start slipped by four days because of rain, but they called before I had to ask. The deck itself is flawless.

testimonials.name: Dan Whitfield
testimonials.quote: Second year running they have handled our common-area fencing. One quote, no surprises, and a crew our residents actually like having around.
